testimonials.name: Lee Morrisseau
testimonials.role: Senior Director Agile Program Management @ Publicis Sapient
testimonials.content: Nikhil deserves recognition for embracing the future through his curiosity and initiative. While he has been delivering strong results on Carter's-optimizing the site for the holidays and resolving difficult, low-occurrence issues-his standout contribution is his self-driven exploration of virtual try-on (VTO) technology using Google's Al tools. He independently built a working proof of concept directly into the website and presented it to account leadership, demonstrating both technical creativity and a forward-thinking mindset. His work aligns perfectly with Carter's ongoing Al initiatives,complementing the intent-powered search POC and helping pave the way for broader Al-enabled solutions. Nikhil's proactive learning and drive to apply emerging technology meaningfully make him an excellent example of innovation in action.

testimonials.name: Senthilkumar Avanasiappan
testimonials.content: Nikhil joined Ariat as an XT developer when there was much backlog work on XT stories. He has picked up faster on project and SFCC technology. He has started greater deliverables from the start and made a lot of impressions with Business and other team members. His approach to the stories is client mindset and process-oriented. This helped the team to deliver better results from the day he joined the team.

testimonials.name: Narayana Guntupalli
testimonials.content: As I observed, Nikhil is good in all the aspects, handling the client requirements and helping each our team to understand the things and if we struck up in middle of UI related issues, he will always helps to get it sorted. He is easily approachable person in any time and good to have such a person in team. I want to nominate to him under openness category.

testimonials.name: Nitika Bansal
testimonials.content: Nikhil joined our project 2 months back only, having great grasping power, the ramping up process become very smooth and he can pick any story independently now with minimalist oversight. He has picked one of the most complex UI stories and delivered without any re-opens. He is totally geared up to follow the industries best practices in writing the code and able to maintain the code quality. Able to understand business requirements and prompt to put forward any risks and assumptions on any tasks assigned to him. I am glad to have him as a part of Ariat Team and with his expertise and problem solving attitude we can deliver complex-to-complex stories
